older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.title: Precision and Recall for Time Series
older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.already_established: Positional weights, cardinality penalties, ordered range overlaps and closed forms.
older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.distinction: Maintain the coupled fixed-label recall and predicted-component precision reducers across all activations/merges, including moving weights, rather than recomputing a mask per threshold.

older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.title: 1D Component Tree in Linear Time and Space and Its Application to Gray-Level Image Multithresholding
older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.already_established: One-dimensional component hierarchies and component attributes.
older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.distinction: The component tree is prior infrastructure; label-conditioned overlap/fragmentation and moving-normalization identities are the specialized additional state.

older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.title: Global gray-level thresholding based on object size
older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.already_established: Per-threshold precision/recall constructed from component-size attributes.
older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.distinction: Their positive mass and recall denominator depend on object size; this work preserves fixed labeled intervals with overlap/cardinality and positional-normalization semantics.

older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.title: Interactive Segmentation Based on Component-trees
older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.primary_text_inspected: Sections 1.1.3 and 3.2, Algorithm 1; fixed binary target G, incrementally computed ps(N,G) and n(N,G).
older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.already_established: Component attributes conditioned on a fixed binary target and dynamic-programming optimization of false-positive/false-negative distance.
older_closest_mechanical_antecedents.distinction: Generic label-conditioned attributes are established; the present specific state couples Tatbul fixed-label overlap/cardinality fragmentation with moving predicted-window positional normalization across the complete threshold trajectory.
